name: Four Seasons Hotel Ritz Lisbon
positioning: Historic 5-star luxury hotel in Lisbon, beside Eduardo VII Park, with Art Deco and Louis XVI-inspired design
best_for: Travelers who want a Michelin-starred restaurant on site
Guests who want a spa, an indoor lap pool and a rooftop running track

facts.text: The hotel has 282 rooms and suites in total.
The hotel rises 10 storeys above the city beside Eduardo VII Park.
The hotel's address is Rua Rodrigo da Fonseca, 88, Lisbon.
The hotel is 650 metres from Marquês de Pombal Square, about a nine-minute walk.
Humberto Delgado Airport is 20 minutes by car from the hotel.
The hotel's design is inspired by Art Deco and Louis XVI style.
CURA, the Portuguese restaurant at the hotel, is distinguished with one Michelin star.
Rodolfo Lavrador is the chef at CURA.
The hotel has a heated 18-metre indoor lap pool.
The Ritz Spa has four treatment rooms.
The hotel has a rooftop running track.
The Almada Negreiros Lounge & Bar serves afternoon tea.

highlights.text: Varanda Restaurant is known for its lavish brunch.
The Royal Suite has three balconies.
The hotel features one of the country's largest and most important privately-owned collections of mid-twentieth century Portuguese art.
Grand Premier Park-View Rooms offer private terraces.
Handwoven tapestries by Portuguese artist José Sobral de Almada Negreiros hang throughout the hotel.

considerations.text: Rossio Square is approximately 2 kilometres from the hotel, about a 25-minute walk or a 10-minute drive.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the hotel's silhouette as midcentury and blockish, dramatic, almost brutal.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the Four Seasons brand positioning.
